title: Pavan
html_source:
A pavan is a type of dance, most likely of Italian origin. It was performed in the processional style and was popular in 16th century Renaissance Europe. Alternate spellings include pavane, paving, pavine, or even pavyn. As exemplified in this video, the pavan was a slow dance. A very, very slow dance.
